# RentSplitter

> Split rent without the awkward conversation

## Overview

RentSplitter provides free tools to split rent fairly among roommates. Built by Jake Morrison, a Portland-based UX designer with 8 years of shared housing experience.

## Key Tools

- Rent Split Calculator — Split by room size, income, or equal shares
- Utility Split Calculator — Divide bills fairly (coming soon)
- Moving Cost Estimator — Plan your move budget (coming soon)
- Roommate Compatibility Quiz — Check compatibility before moving in (coming soon)

## Blog Topics

- Roommate horror stories and lessons learned
- How to split rent fairly (square footage, income-based, custom weights)
- Utility bill tracking and fair division
- Security deposit rights and recovery
- Moving checklists and first-apartment guides
- Money conversations with roommates
